description: Run Antigravity CLI as a detached background task. Subactions: start (returns taskId), status, tail (log output), stop, remove, list. Use for long-running autonomous work — the MCP call returns immediately and you poll status later.

effort.description: Reasoning effort (--effort). Supported levels depend on the model — see list-models. Use with a base model ID (e.g. gemini-4-hydrogen); not supported by Orchestrator.

label.description: Human-readable label to identify this task later.

lines.description: Lines to return from log tail.

mode.description: Agent mode (--mode): accept-edits, auto (sandboxed autonomy; not available on every account), or plan (answers go into a plan artifact).

model.description: Optional model override. Known: Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low), Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Medium), Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High), Gemini 4 Hydrogen (XHigh), Gemini 4 Argon (Low), Gemini 4 Argon (Medium), Gemini 4 Argon (High), Gemini 4 Carbon (Low), Gemini 4 Carbon (Medium), Gemini 4 Carbon (High), Orchestrator (Argon), Orchestrator (Carbon), Gemini 3.8 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.8 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.8 Flash (High), Claude Opus 5.5 (Low), Claude Opus 5.5 (Medium), Claude Opus 5.5 (High), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Low), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Medium), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (High), GPT-OSS 120B (Medium).

signal.description: Signal for action=stop (default SIGTERM; SIGKILL for a run that ignores it).

skipPermissions.description: --dangerously-skip-permissions. Default: true (print mode can't answer permission prompts), false when `mode` is set. Not allowed with mode plan.

timeout.description: agy --print-timeout in milliseconds. Omit for no limit (agy waits for the turn and its background tasks).

name: bg-antigravity
